blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
You'll now learn how to display structured reference information clearly — the kind of content blogs and docs use when explaining concepts side-by-side.
The most popular structure to present information in such a format is, obviously, a table.
So this lesson is solely dedicated to learning just that.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
